title: CauProphet: Teaching Agents to Develop Causal Cognition like Humans
abstract: arXiv:2610.32477v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly support long-horizon tasks by leveraging external memory and past experience. However, existing agents mainly retrieve records or summaries, lacking the ability to form and refine causal understanding of the world. Inspired by human causal cognition, we introduce CauProphet, an agent that develops and updates causal knowledge within its Causal Cognition. For each task, CauProphet combines relevant knowledge in Causal Cognition with current evidence to construct a Causal Belief, a structured belief capturing causal factors and the effects of possible actions. It uses this belief for decision-making and continuously updates both the belief and Causal Cognition as new observations emerge, enabling causal knowledge that persists beyond individual experiences. Evaluations demonstrate that CauProphet progressively acquires causal knowledge and transfers it to future decision-making. In financial r

translated_title: CauProphet：教会智能体像人类一样发展因果认知
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体日益通过利用外部记忆和过往经验来支持长时程任务。然而，现有的智能体主要检索记录或摘要，缺乏形成并完善对世界的因果理解的能力。受人类因果认知的启发，我们提出了CauProphet，这是一个能在其“因果认知”中发展和更新因果知识的智能体。对于每项任务，CauProphet将因果认知中的相关知识与当前证据相结合，构建一个“因果信念”——一种能够捕捉因果因素以及各种可能行动效果的结构化信念。它利用这一信念进行决策，并随着新观察结果的出现持续更新信念和因果认知，从而使因果知识能够超越个体经验而持久存在。评估结果表明，CauProphet能够逐步习得因果知识，并将其迁移应用于未来的决策中。在金融……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CauProphet智能体，通过构建结构化的“因果信念”并在“因果认知”中持续更新因果知识，使大语言模型智能体能够像人类一样习得因果理解，并将其迁移应用于未来的决策任务。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CauProphet, an LLM agent that develops human-like causal cognition by constructing structured Causal Beliefs and continuously updating causal knowledge within its Causal Cognition, enabling the acquisition and transfer of causal understanding to future decision-making.
